::: {#perfil}

Professor at the FGV School of Applied Mathematics (EMAp) and coordinator of the GAIA Lab. He was a senior researcher at IBM Research, 
research scientist at GE Global Research, and guest professor at the Technical University of Munich (TUM). His research focuses on 
machine learning and deep learning applied to remote sensing, sustainability, climate, forests, and digital agriculture.

## Education

- PhD in Electrical Engineering (image analysis and computer vision), PUC-Rio.
- MSc in Electrical Engineering, PUC-Rio.
- BSc in Electrical Engineering, UERJ.

## Interests

Spatiotemporal AI, remote sensing, sustainability, climate, forests, and digital agriculture.
